## How to test

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests for success and failure paths
- [ ] Authorization tested for new endpoints
- [ ] Loading, empty, error and content states (data screens)
- [ ] Lint, format, analyze and type check pass
- [ ] No secret or real personal data
- [ ] API contract and docs updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] AI assistance logged in `docs/ai-usage.md`, and I can explain every line
